pos.personaBrief: Allegri's Juventus accepted passivity without the ball, compressing space and waiting for errors (Tifo, Coaches' Voice), and he was content to let Lazio have the ball; build-up is built to avoid risk (Hudl).

pro.personaBrief: Hudl says Juve avoid elaborate first-phase play and central passes, building wide with many switches; after regaining the ball he asked for patience then speed (2021).

est.personaBrief: Structured, role-based blocks (3-5-2, 4-4-2, 5-3-2) with wing-backs holding width, yet his 4-2-3-1 asked forwards and wingers to drop between the lines (SoccerTutor).

lar.personaBrief: Wide build-up with switches and width from wing-backs (Coaches' Voice, Hudl, theScore), but a preference for an extra central midfielder over wingers; the wide route is mainly by wing-backs and full-backs.

blo.personaBrief: Disciplined, reserved block, passive 4-4-2 or 5-3-2 sitting deep and funnelling wide, pressing only in particular situations (Coaches' Voice, Tifo, Hudl).

mar.personaBrief: Zonal block with ball-oriented, man-oriented duties in pressing (Hudl); occasional dedicated man-marking such as Muntari on Xavi, and box packed against crosses.

pla.personaBrief: Formation-flexible, adapting to players and to the opponent's shape, sometimes mid-match (Coaches' Voice, Tifo); 'football is also strategy' (2021).

res.personaBrief: Pragmatic result-first coach, 'corto muso', conservative approach criticised but effective (Hudl); defends leads and frustrates opponents.

sis.personaBrief: Tactical duties applied to all and sacrifice without the ball valued (Hudl), a system-minded coach, though he stated that champions matter more than schemes and shaped roles around Dybala and Higuain.

jog.personaBrief: Mixed: technical passing midfielders such as Pjanic and Khedira and Dybala as the 10, alongside tall, athletic mezzali (Hudl) and a block that wins crosses and duels.

bas.personaBrief: Built Juve around veterans and champions (Bonucci, Chiellini, Barzagli, Ronaldo); young players like Miretti and Fagioli got chances mostly through injuries (Goal.com).

lid.personaBrief: Relaxed but firm manager (Ibrahimovic), listens to the group, kept the dressing room calm, yet the Bonucci case showed he decides alone and applies rules to stars.
